name: University of Padua founded
summary: A secession of masters and students from Bologna founds the Studium Generale at Padua, in protest at infringements on Bolognese scholarly privilege. Padua develops particular strength in law and, from the 14th century, in medicine and natural philosophy.

_quarry.structural_significance: One of Italy's three foundational medieval universities (Bologna, Padua, Naples); the Paduan medical-Aristotelian tradition shapes early modern science via Vesalius and Galileo.
